mode_meaning.contaminated: Team inputs are season-to-date leaderboards, so every graded game sits inside its own features. This measures calibration, not skill, and it cannot validate anything.
mode_meaning.vintage: Every game is priced on a leaderboard snapshot whose knowledge cutoff is strictly before that game: team offense, team run prevention, the listed probable and the park index all come out of that snapshot. A game with no such snapshot is skipped, not graded on today's numbers, and a game whose snapshot predates the stored park column is priced with the park term at neutral rather than on the live index. This is the only mode that can validate the model.

graded_blocks.note: 258 games graded on vintage features; 600 are needed before min_edge may be fitted, and the paired-Brier gate must also clear. 11 of the eval games carry no park term at all (their vintage predates the park column); the park index is NOT borrowed from the live file, which would leak the in-progress season

park_basis.note: the park index is read from each game's own vintage record; a record written before the park column existed prices its games on a NEUTRAL park (the park term drops out) rather than on the live index, which is the in-progress season and would leak the eval window into its own features

gates.why: the contaminated forward margin over the home-field baseline is +0.005794 Brier with a paired sd of 0.08647, so a margin that size needs 603 games to clear one-sided 95%; 600 is that number, and a clean margin will be smaller, so this is a floor and not a pass

gates.need: paired Brier vs the home-field baseline, t >= 1.645
gates.why: sample size is not evidence; the model has to actually beat 'always take the home team' on games it could not see

gates.need: settled bets with a taken price, enough that some edge threshold clears an ROI lower bound of zero on at least 100 of them, WITHIN ONE TAG

gates.why: an edge threshold is a claim about EV against real prices; 8 dates of odds snapshots are cached. The sweep runs per tag and a tag opens only if it individually clears - a pooled ROI measures a mixture nobody bet
gates.pooled_is_not_sweepable: `have` is the union of every tag and is never swept; see by_tag for the four clocks that are

gate.policy: min_edge stays null until all three gates are open. A threshold invented to make a pick appear is the single most dishonest number this module could publish.

validation.note: Two modes, both labelled. The in-sample and forward numbers are CONTAMINATED: their features are season-to-date leaderboards that contain the games being graded. The vintage number is the honest one and it graded 258 games. A pick threshold is set from the vintage mode or from nothing.

record.chain_note: sha256 folded row by row over the record; a record that still contains an archived value as one of its prefix hashes is an append, and one that does not is a rewrite
